<!-- pr-reviewer: 583d05fdab639b43c3181e10f2b5e6dba46e47f1 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good:
- The guide reader changes CRLF to LF before the existing checks run.
- The new test constructs CRLF fences and checks the examples against the live MCP schema.
- The existing assertions remain in place. The decision note explains the selected fix.

Results, run locally after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `ad0307b7a949adf5629daaf61b8e326bb4de0fe0`:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed, 1 step, 0 failures. The `ai_guide` suite compiled and ran all 3 tests: 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo clippy -j 12 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: the diff reaches no heavy lane.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: passed. The release build and both light tests passed: `the_slot_keeps_its_verdict_under_sub_micron_perturbations_light` and `wide_rectangular_pocket_is_cleared_by_parallel_lanes_light`.

Extra suites run:
- None required by the extra selection rules. The diff changes no fixture, golden, or importer.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:
- This change affects tests only. It changes no posted G-code, geometry, collision check, gouge check, or stock simulation. Safety mutations do not apply.
- No UI code changes, so screenshots do not apply.
- A native Windows run was not performed. The regression test checks generated CRLF text on Linux.
- Cargo reports the existing unused workspace dependency `truck-polymesh`. Clippy exits successfully with `-D warnings`.
- The review uses the current upstream/main AGENTS.md. No code or review evidence was added to the PR branch.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
